tools.name: clear_filters
tools.description: Remove every filter — text query, date range, attachment toggle — and return the reader to the whole mailbox in file order.

tools.name: filter_by_date
tools.description: Narrow the reader to a date range and/or change the sort order. Works instantly on any mailbox size because dates are already indexed. Updates what the person sees on screen. Does not do text search — that is scan_messages.

from.description: Earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no lower bound.

to.description: Latest date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for no upper bound.

tools.name: get_mailbox_status
tools.description: Report whether an MBOX file is open in this tab and what is in it: message count, date span, how many messages the current filters match, and whether the mailbox is fully readable. Call this first.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages currently shown in the reader, newest-first or in whatever order the page is sorted by. Returns index, date, sender and subject only. Cheap at any mailbox size. Use read_message for the body.

offset.description: Start position in the current view. Default 0.

limit.description: How many to return, up to 50. Default 25.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one message in full: headers, plain-text body, and the names and sizes of its attachments. Attachment contents are not available. Use an index from list_messages or scan_messages.

tools.name: scan_messages
tools.description: Search subjects and senders for text, and/or find messages with attachments, optionally within a date range. This reads each message from disk, so it works in bounded passes: if the result says done=false, call again with the returned cursor to continue from where it stopped. Results are reported but do not change what is on screen.

query.description: Text to look for in subject or sender. Case-insensitive.

cursor.description: Resume position from a previous call. Omit to start at the beginning.
